name: Hyland (2005) interactional metadiscourse: hedges and boosters
original: Hyland, K. (2005). Metadiscourse: Exploring Interaction in Writing. London: Continuum. Appendix list of metadiscourse items (pp. 218-224).
transcribed_from: Nasirizadeh, Z. & Paramasivam, S., 'Stance markers in forestry research articles: indicators of authoritative voice', Discourse and Interaction (Masaryk University), Table 1 'Interactional model of metadiscourse (Hyland 2005)', https://journals.muni.cz/discourse-and-interaction/article/download/36731/32864/65841 (fetched 2026-10-01 PT)
transcription_notes: Copied from the secondary reproduction, not from the book. The reproduction's item 'from our ,' was read as 'from our perspective'. Single-word items are matched as whole words, so 'claim' does not match 'claimed' unless 'claimed' is also listed (as in the original). The list was built for academic prose; words such as 'about', 'would', 'could' and 'may' are also used non-hedgingly, so counts overstate hedging. Use as a reading prompt, not a measurement of intent.
